peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 2.2% below its local comparables; 26 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (93.4): 4.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 85 of 91 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 95.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,140,000 ($1,177 psf, 904–1,302 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,177 psf (range $964–1,321); 0% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $0 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,373,000 ($1,200 psf, 1,119–1,184 sq ft; 12 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,255 psf (range $966–1,401); 4.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $63,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Simei MRT about 600 m, Upper Changi MRT about 1,220 m; closer than 35 of 94 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Changkat Primary School about 270 m; more than 19 of 94 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 550 m), more than 82 of 94 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 990 m; nearest park Bedok Reservoir Park about 1,670 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,280 m; Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,380 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 43 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,111 new sales and 582 resales (1,693 purchases); new sales were 65.6% of these purchases. Subsales (10) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,430 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 582 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 73 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 582 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 710 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−18%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
